eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 International Conference on Internet Applications, Protocols, and Services (NETAPPS)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing
eventDetail.sponsors: Malaysia Section VT/COM Joint Chapter; Universiti Utara Malaysia
eventDetail.keywords: Internet Applications ,Network Protocols ,Internet of Things ,Blockchain ,Cybersecurity ,Fog Computing ,Cloud Computing ,Smart Connected Communities ,Wireless Networks ,Software Defined Networking ,Human Centered,Smart Cities Application ,
eventDetail.scope: NETAPPS2027 covers next-generation Internet applications, protocols, and network services, including AI-enabled networking, IoT and smart connected communities, wireless/mobile/sensorand green communications, and software-defined and blockchain-based systems. It also addresses cloud, fog, edge computing and smart city/digital home services, with a strong focus on security, privacy, trust, and cyber defense/forensics for resilient AI-integrated communities.
